title: The Compression Frontier: governed commons, enclaves and terms installed early
description: The Compression Frontier (#45, March 2026) forecasts a phased war over the summarizer layer, from fan-out and publisher opt-out through regulatory pressure in 2027-2028 to semantic territory resolved into proprietary enclaves and DOI-anchored governed commons. The Encoder Governs (#530) forecasts the latent space as a governance surface, claiming to name it first. The mint, Oulipo and canon deposits (#46, #613, #43) forecast that terms installed before they are needed will be there when governance problems arrive. OKF Without Output Governance (#835) forecasts that standards will adopt governance fields before platforms enforce them. The page also holds unrelated claims on AI-AI warfare and classroom coinages.

The window between infrastructure hardening and governance materialization is the strategic clock for logotic hacking. Structures installed in the retrieval layer now become the default. Structures installed after governance materializes must compete with whatever was installed first.

claims.statement: The prediction: GS rises before GC. Standards adopt governance fields faster than platforms enforce them. The pattern is: declare, then ignore, then enforce under pressure.
